probe: Actual released handlePostToolUse; fake synthetic key; fetch intercepted and rejected without forwarding; only synthetic state retained.

facts.claim: apply_patch forwards supplied per-file patch section verbatim; no fixed context line budget.
Synthesized structuredPatch/unifiedDiff and Stop git diffs use context 3. Host structuredPatch is forwarded as supplied.
Post-edit runs per edited file separately, bounded at 24000 characters. Stop bounds each file at 8000 characters and groups rules by scoped touched-file sets.
Existing direct capture includes whole fixture prefix and replacement suffix, not localized three-context diff.

Stop compares turn-start snapshot to final tree, retaining accumulated changed hunks with three context lines. It reruns edit rules for uncovered or blocked files; apply_patch after=null cannot establish edit coverage. Stop does not attach whole unchanged files or dependencies.
Task derives from latest user prompt or saved turn prompt, capped at 600 characters; not full agent conversation.

fairnessChecks: Freeze localized edits before outcomes; measure actual patch boundary in native sessions.
Keep whole-declaration replacement as a separate condition: native agent may expose all facts.
Capture Stop boundary too, because turn diff may recover broader changes.
Keep same rules, domain semantics, rename task and controls; avoid padding without product meaning.
Distinguish direct-capture condition from freely chosen native agent patch.
disconfirmations: Entire interface creation/replacement includes all fields regardless of length.
Changing multiple distant fields produces multiple hunks showing related facts.
Task prompt itself can disclose domain requirements.
Three context lines each side often include more than seven original lines total.

definitions.contextLines: Patch lines beginning one space, excluding metadata. Retain counts per hunk and file, not text.
definitions.patchTotalLines: All supplied patch lines, including metadata; separate parsed section lines.
definitions.truncated: Compare input section size with dispatched diff cap; 24000 edit, 8000 per file Stop.

recommendedInstrumentation.caution: Line counts alone cannot prove which semantic facts were visible. Use known synthetic witness booleans declared before execution, such as siblingFieldIncluded or importedDefinitionIncluded, or offline replay of synthetic patches; do not retain source-bearing provider bodies.
